take.bookTitle: The making of the LEGO Odyssey

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: Quiet on the set. And... action.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: Cut. We have a set built of real bricks. We have voices, and faces that move their lips. And the characters do nothing.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Not by moving them for the sake of it. Every movement needs a cause.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: First the voice: what is said. Then the intent: what he wants. Then the body that carries it out: the head, the arms, the weight.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: And if he stands still, he stands still for a reason.

segments.speaker: odysseus
segments.caption: Tell me, O Muse, of that ingenious hero who travelled far and wide after he had sacked the famous town of Troy.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: He turned to the horse. Why?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Because the line names Troy. Ask the engine why any figure moves, and it tells you the cause.
